recipe.visualDefinition: A surrealist composition featuring three male heads in profile, layered sequentially from left to right, emerging from a single white scarf-like structure that trails off into the sky. The scene is set against a deep blue to light cyan gradient sky filled with scattered, soft white clouds, topped by a dark, almost black upper atmosphere where large, condensed yellow lettering resides.
coreVisualRelationships: Sequential layering of faces creating a sense of motion or multiplicity
Contrast between the bright yellow geometric type and the soft airbrushed organic forms
Integration of typography with background elements, where clouds overlap the letters
The scarf acting as a unified base for three distinct identities
coreInvariants: Condensed, high-contrast serif typography in bright yellow
Three-quarter profile perspective for the portraits
Airbrushed texture with soft transitions and high-key highlights on skin
Deep blue to light blue vertical gradient background

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Three heads occupy the lower two-thirds of the frame, centered horizontally but staggered in depth.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The largest, rightmost head serves as the primary focal point due to its scale and central placement.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye moves from the large yellow title at the top, down to the faces, and follows the trailing scarf toward the right edge.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant negative space in the upper third provides a stage for the typography and dark sky.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep blue and cyan gradient background providing a cool atmospheric base.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright lemon yellow for the display typography.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Warm skin tones and white highlights on the clouds and scarf.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the dark upper sky and the bright yellow text; medium saturation in the blues.

letterConstructionRules: Uniform stroke weight on vertical stems
characterSpecificRedesigns: Elongated stems that extend to the top edge of the frame
Strategic overlapping by cloud elements to embed the text into the scene
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single dominant typeface used for maximum impact against a complex illustration.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the extreme verticality and high contrast serifs.
Provides the correct modern serif structure and vertical stress.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a surrealist airbrush painting of three men's heads in profile, staggered from left to right. They should emerge from a single white flowing scarf. The background is a gradient from black at the top to light blue at the bottom, with soft white clouds scattered throughout.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the title text in a large, extra-condensed yellow serif font at the top. Mask parts of the letters with the clouds from the background to create depth.

verificationChecks: Text is bright yellow and extra-condensed
Three heads are clearly visible in a staggered profile
Background has a vertical color gradient

adjustableVariables: Amount of cloud overlap on text
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the individuals
Any existing band logos or record label marks
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the yellow text is legible but partially obscured by clouds
Check that the scarf texture looks soft and fabric-like
Verify the gradient transition is smooth without banding
Confirm the three-quarter profile perspective is consistent across all heads
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [Surrealist Airbrush Portraiture] with [Extra-Condensed Modern Serif Typography] set against an [Atmospheric Sky Gradient] where [Environmental Elements Overlap Text].
